plan.title: Submit RFQ bid after technical response

steps.note: Open the prepared Tech+RFQ event's technical round as required by the prepared-state setup.
Continue in Vendor A's supplier-portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the commercial RFQ stage after the technical response has been completed.
Accept any required terms as part of the bid flow, enter a quote of 100, and submit it.
Verify that the vendor portal accepted the RFQ submission.
Return to the buyer's event page to inspect the submitted commercial response.
Open the buyer's comparison grid for the submitted bid.
Verify that the submitted vendor appears as a real vendor column in Master QCS.
Verify that Master QCS shows the submitted commercial price of 100.
